purpose: Teach: 管内/称号/単調/対称/要綱/パイオニア/訳注/経団連

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、大学管内の研究室を見学しろ
lines.en: Ren — visit the labs here on campus.
lines.style: Direct, measured instruction. Clear authority without edge. Lean forward slightly, eyes steady on him. One beat of weight behind the command.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。博士称号にふさわしい研究を目指します
lines.en: Yes. I'm aiming to become research worthy of a doctorate.
lines.style: Careful, earnest commitment. Slight tension in the throat — trying to sound worthy, not just eager. Pause before 'doctorate,' letting the weight of it settle. Eyes up to meet his.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、単調なデータ収集も大事だ
lines.en: Ren — even monotonous data collection matters.
lines.style: Steady, almost gentle insistence. No condescension. A quiet teacher's voice: this is important because it's true, not because it sounds impressive. Slight nod forward on 'matters.'

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験を対称的に組みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll design the experiments with that rigor in mind.
lines.style: Quick uptake, absorbing the correction. Slight relief — he was right to say it. Softer energy than before, more grounded. A small nod acknowledging the lesson.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究倫理要綱を熟読しろ
lines.en: Ren — read the research ethics guidelines thoroughly.
lines.style: Weight behind this one. Not punishing, but serious. Eyes narrow slightly. The tone that says: this is non-negotiable, and I'm telling you because I respect you enough to be clear.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。分野のパイオニアの論文を学びます
lines.en: Yes. I'll study the papers from the field's pioneers.
lines.style: Eager to prove understanding, maybe slightly scrambling to show he gets the importance. Quick agreement. Breath catches slightly after 'yes,' like he's taking mental notes mid-sentence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文には訳注も添えろ
lines.en: Ren — include translator's notes with the papers.
lines.style: Clipped, final instruction. Less explanation needed now — he's listening. Slight chin lift, almost dismissive of protest. The tone of someone wrapping up a meeting.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。経団連と大学の連携にも関心があります
lines.en: Yes. I'm also interested in how Keidanren partners with universities on this.
lines.style: Opening up slightly after the directives. Softer than before. He's volunteering something beyond the task — showing thought, initiative. Slight warmth creeping in, like he's beginning to trust the space to think out loud.
